assumption: Existing hash-verified inputs reproduce historical fits under the pinned implementations.
success: Replay <= 1e-9; complete registered population; every arm produces scores or an explicit failure.
falsification: Hash/population/fold/replay mismatch stops every dependent stage without changing tolerance.
fit_scope: One transductive, label-free fit per model/dataset cell; no external evaluation.

removal.targeted: Greedy highest mean absolute Spearman with other remaining LEVEL channels within cell; lexical tie.
removal.random: One permutation of lexically sorted five LEVEL channels, numpy default_rng(20261003); first k, shared across banks/cells.
removal.lf_orientation: Recompute raw pool LEVEL mean from remaining LEVEL channels; Pearson sign per cell; record signs relative to original.

anchor: q15_H1 if surviving; else surviving LEVEL with highest DS pi; else any survivor highest DS pi; lexical ties.
matched_control: Same bank/removal/partition/within/position/quota with EQ between; ungrouped DS_FILTER_EQ is also reported.

estimators.MOM: tensor_mom_estimate(votes,anchor) -> mle_weights; log b, prevalence, out_of_range
estimators.SML: sml_estimate for reliability ranking only; fusion_utils.sml_fuse_signed on continuous group scores for weights

experiment2.a: Original banks: channel votes versus group votes. Partition fixed. Channel log-odds mapped to groups by mean within each group; matched group score matrices and EQ controls.
experiment2.b: Original banks: per-answer versus per-cell quota, crossed with channel/group estimator input. Freeze partition and continuous group scores from original per-answer fit.
experiment2.quota: Rank same answer-standardized column values with same random tie key. Preserve sum ceil(.2*n_answer) marks per column per cell exactly.
experiment2.truth: PRMBench only. Sensitivity/specificity MAE, prevalence absolute error, reliability Spearman. SML has no sensitivity/specificity.

position.pos: Ungrouped append position then DS filter as historical; grouped append position to fixed group score matrix and apply same between estimator.
position.prior: Historical 10-bin position DS prior and latent slope; record convergence, clipping and minimum 50 rows per bin.
position.crossfit: Whole groups greedily assigned descending size then group ID to smaller channel-count side, A on ties. No alternate splitting. At least 3 channels per side. Opposite-half channel-vote latent posterior calibrates each side score; normalize recipe group weights locally by sum abs. Add prior. Log content change.
position.nulls: 200 fixed permutations; PRMB er_stage_b2 shuffle_within/swap_same_length; PB shuffle valid first-error position and swap full target within cell/length including -1; log singletons.
position.equal_share: 0.5 * answer_z(content) + 0.5 * POSZ; diagnostic, not causal attribution.

decisions.q80: Threshold at numpy quantile .8 of same-cell answer-z scores; >= flags; earliest flagged step for PB.
decisions.r2: Count flags from q80 on mean of surviving raw channels standardized over same cell; assign that count to highest recipe step scores; earliest ties.
decisions.gate: Compute entropy OFFSET = answer_z(score)+cell_z(mean token entropy); q80 gives target fraction with no flags. Close least-entropy answers to this fraction (ceil, stable UID ties); use frozen q80 inside open answers. New per-cell adaptation, not historical pure-gate replay.
decisions.top_2: Historical post hoc choice; report all three.
decisions.final_choice: Omri chooses after comparison. No automatic decision freeze or external run.

lr.inner: Leave one remaining source fold out; balanced log loss; smallest C wins ties.
lr.report: Foldwise OOF metrics; in-sample diagnostics separate; no cross-fold pooled AUROC or test-label sign flips.
lr.pb_labels: Train on clean steps and erroneous prefix through first error; exclude post-error training labels. Score all steps.

failure: No silent mean fallback; fewer than 3 groups/votes fail dependent arms; failed cells remain in denominators. Record SML 3-group guard and HEM small-group guard.

replay.Step457: Fold 0 evaluation; PRMB folds 2,3,4 DS fit; all-cell folds 2,3,4 partition fit; original pooled lf signs.
replay.Step462: All 9 per-cell fits for B16/B23/B35/B54: BASE and GRP against frozen per_dataset_fit_v1 scores.
replay.zero_removal: Exact original-bank equality for all 8 banks and all 9 cells.

statistics.pairing: Shared resampling draws across all banks, recipes and backbones within benchmark.
statistics.primary: Content-only within-answer AUC paired advantage against matched EQ. PRMBench only; PB first-error/official F1 separate.
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni simultaneous intervals across all registered primary bank/variant/weighted-recipe contrasts within each experiment. Include unadjusted 95% intervals. Secondary contrasts descriptive with 95% intervals.
statistics.selection: Largest equal-weight mean matched advantage across 8 banks; no missing cells. Report all absolute scores and losses.
statistics.legacy: Also report Step457: no bank with significant loss at paired 95%; report historical full rule separately from new selection.

combined: Combine selected removal and input change, test full population plus each component alone, original control, matched EQ and LR. Refit all changed stages. No stitched historical scores.
disk: No full checkout, no moved worktrees. Inform Omri before >200MB expected writes. Compact per-source sufficient statistics; step scores only main/final recipes.
review: Claude independently recomputes headlines, coverage, shuffled-label null before deck. Pending review is never a conclusion.
